name: Web page reader
about: Reads any web page or JSON URL as clean text or Markdown. No account needed.
try: read https://go.dev/doc/effective_go and list the five most important rules

name: Library docs (Context7)
about: Looks up current documentation and code examples for popular libraries and frameworks. Works without a key.
try: using context7, show me how to set up routing in the newest Next.js

name: GitHub repo explainer (DeepWiki)
about: Answers questions about how any public GitHub repository is built. Remote service, nothing to install, no account.
try: ask deepwiki how the router in expressjs/express matches a request

name: GitHub (issues, pull requests, code)
about: Reads and searches issues, pull requests and code on GitHub. Free account and a free token needed.

needs.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
needs.where: https://github.com/settings/tokens (create a token, the repo scope is enough for reading)

try: list the open issues in my repo and tell me which one to fix first

name: Web search (Tavily)
about: Searches the web and extracts pages, so Prism can look things up. Free plan: 1000 searches a month, no card.

needs.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
needs.where: https://app.tavily.com (sign up free, copy the API key)

try: search the web for the latest stable Go release and what changed in it

name: Git tools
about: Proper git tools: log, diff, blame, branches, commits, instead of shell commands.
try: set the git folder to this project, then summarize the last 5 commits

name: Notebook (knowledge graph memory)
about: Lets Prism store facts about you, people and projects as a small graph and recall them later in the same folder.
try: remember that the staging server is called atlas and the deploy is done on Fridays

name: Step-by-step thinking
about: Gives Prism a scratchpad to break hard problems into steps and revise them. Helps smaller free models.
try: think step by step about how to migrate this app from REST to GraphQL

name: Extra file tools
about: Directory trees, file search and bulk reads inside this project. Prism already reads and edits files, so add this only if you want those extras.
try: show the directory tree of this project and find every file that mentions TODO
